)

new_features = "        GATEWAY_LINK_FEATURE_PERMIT_JOIN | GATEWAY_LINK_FEATURE_CAPABILITY_PROFILE |\n        GATEWAY_LINK_FEATURE_COMMANDS));"

    raise SystemExit(f"expected two control feature masks, got {text.count(old_features)}")
write("tests/host/test_gateway_link_control.c", text.replace(old_features, new_features, 2))
'''
if old not in s:

p.write_text(s.replace(old, new, 1))
